stories.title: Barnwell: Five NFL teams -- including the Broncos -- that will take a step back this season
stories.summary: Are the Bears getting too much hype? Did the Panthers and Jaguars overachieve last season? And will the Broncos and Patriots come up short of expectations this season?

stories.title: The five NFL teams most likely to improve: Why the Chiefs lead Barnwell's annual list
stories.summary: Can the Giants and Jets improve on their awful 2025 records? Will the Chiefs, Lions and Ravens rebound?

stories.title: Study: At least 1 in 4 NFL players can get CTE
stories.summary: A new study published Tuesday by the British Medical Journal showed that at least 25% of NFL players who died between 2016 and 2021 had CTE.

stories.title: Reese sets 2 WNBA rebounding records with 26
stories.summary: Angel Reese set a WNBA record with 26 rebounds in the Dream's 78-71 win over the Sparks on Monday, pushing her past the league's season record in the same game.

stories.title: Pro athletes planning to return to NCAA irks SEC
stories.summary: As LSU hopes to sign NFL tight end Dae'Quan Wright, if he clears waivers, the SEC on Monday issued a statement emphasizing its belief that athletes who choose to leave to sign pro contracts "should not then be permitted to return to college competition."
